description: Replace parts of an existing artifact with content you wrote, keeping its folder ID, link and sharing. Only what is sent changes: each listed file is written (null deletes it), each edit replaces one exact match of its find text in an existing text file, description replaces the card text, and title renames it; every other file is kept. Prefer edits for small changes to a large file. Read the current files with list_files and read_file first. Requires write permission. To have Replo's agent revise it from a request in words, use generate_artifact with fileId.

description.description: The one-line summary shown on the artifact's card.

edits.description: Targeted replacements in existing text files, applied in order, so a small change doesn't resend the whole file. If any edit fails to match exactly once, nothing is saved. A path can't appear in both files and edits.

find.description: Exact text to replace, not a pattern. It must appear exactly once in the file; include surrounding lines to make it unique.

path.description: A path relative to the artifact folder, such as index.html, styles.css or images/logo.png.

fileId.description: The .artifact folder ID, including for Insights artifacts; never an embedded report file ID.

anyOf.description: The file's text, or { base64 } for binary files such as images and fonts. The content type comes from the extension.

files.description: Files to write, keyed by relative path; null deletes that file. Files not listed are kept. index.html is the page. Link sibling files with relative URLs; scripts may load only from the artifact, cdnjs, jsDelivr /npm/, unpkg, the Tailwind CDN and the jQuery CDN, and other outbound requests are blocked. Each *.insights.json file is an Insights report document (version "2.0", the shape get_insights_report returns) whose saved queries run live for each viewer; embed one with <replo-report src="./sales.insights.json"></replo-report>. report.insights.json is the artifact's main report, the one the Insights report tools read, and without index.html Replo renders the page around it.

propertyNames.description: A path relative to the artifact folder, such as index.html, styles.css or images/logo.png.

name: update_artifact
title: Update artifact
